entries.338ea22b9c8f9fea: The core business, which supports customer companies' recruitment and use of personnel through internet job sites and the like, has revenue from external customers of ¥48,239 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026. The breakdown is media (job advertising) services of ¥46,048 million, agent (placement) services of ¥1,848 million, and other services of ¥342 million. The company operates the part-time job site 'Baitoru', the spot part-time job service 'Spot Baitoru', the full-time and contract job site 'Baitoru NEXT', the general job site 'Hatarakonet', the professional job site 'Baitoru PRO', the nurse placement service 'Nurse de Hatarako', and the caregiver placement service 'Kaigo de Hatarako'.
entries.339ea23d7831e650: A business that provides the 'Cobot' series of SaaS-type DX services, packaged with a narrowed set of functions designed for mid-sized and small and medium-sized enterprises, supporting the DX of these companies; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 is ¥6,613 million. Products include Recruitment Page Cobot, Interview Cobot, HR and Labor Cobot, HR Cobot, Regular Customer Cobot forLINE, Customer Attraction Cobot for MEO, Customer Attraction Cobot forSNSBooster and others.
entries.8a0d527f4a4bced4: The company is headquartered in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and the group consists of the company, 1 consolidated subsidiary (a corporate venture capital fund), and 2 equity-method affiliates. The company has 2 reportable segments, the Human Resources Services Business and the DX Business, and consolidated employees as of February 28, 2026 numbered 2,663.
entries.e113f878daa59465: A company that provides staffing and recruitment services, including the part-time job site "Baitoru", and the DX service "Cobot" for mid-sized and small businesses.
